correctness.rationale: The matching-to-cyclic-tiling classification is complete for n>=4; square toggles connect the tiling component. For odd n, every matching in that component has an odd positive chord count. Any single alternating cycle linking a zero-chord perimeter matching to it has an odd number of chords, giving rim displacement n (mod 2n), hence at least n perimeter edges and total length >=n+1. For each chord one and only one n-edge semicircle alternates against each perimeter matching, giving n exact length-n+1 bridges from each; no shorter cycle changes components. The independent finite exhaustive scripts check all matchings n=4..13 and cyclic-tiling configurations n=4..18, but the proof is the infinite certificate.
